facts.value: Aggregates the current effective damage of an item's non-disabled attack capsules for downstream item interaction and projectile-release logic. The result is the greatest qualifying damage relative to an initial zero accumulator, not necessarily the strongest unmodified configured base damage.
facts.rationale: The query reads HitCapsule.damage. The common assignment path distinguishes its stored integer damage from effective damage computed through fighter-owner scale and attack-instance processing, so the existing base-damage characterization is inaccurate.

evidence.why: Shows the non-disabled guards and zero-seeded reduction over HitCapsule.damage.
Shows effective damage being derived separately from the stored integer through owner-dependent processing.
